title: Mynd Domains Subdomain Application
description: Application for a Mynd Domains subdomain (yourname.mynd.my.id)

subdomain.description: The desired subdomain (e.g., 'myproject'). Must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens, 1-63 chars, RFC 1035 compliant.

email.description: A valid email address where we can reach you.

github.description: Your GitHub username (without @). Must match the PR author.

discord.description: Your Discord username. Must match a member of our server.

description.description: A clear description of what you are building.

purpose.description: Why you need a Mynd Domains subdomain specifically.

url.description: If your project is already live, link it here. (Optional)

acceptedRules.description: Must be true. Indicates you have read and accepted the rules in CONTRIBUTING.md.

joinedDiscord.description: Must be true. Indicates you have joined the Mynd Labs Discord server.
